summary:
Fixed the memory-ordering bug in [ring_buffer.c](/app/ring_buffer.c) and updated the matching note in [ring_buffer.h](/app/ring_buffer.h).

What changed:
- Producer now publishes `write_idx` with `memory_order_release`.
- Consumer now reads `write_idx` with `memory_order_acquire`.
- Consumer releases `read_idx` after reading the slot.
- Producer acquires `read_idx` before reusing slots.
- Simplified the empty check to `r == w`.

Verification: `./test.sh` passes. TSan cannot run in this container, so the script used its fallback correctness loop; all 5 optimized runs passed with no corruption.
